notes.title: 50% Discount on HER MAJESTY's SHIP from the 28th of October 2019
notes.content:
We have listened to all the feedback and will be launching a huge update along with a 50% price discount on the 28th of October 2019.

* New interactive tutorial
* Refreshed UI / UX
* New Endless Play Mode
* Improved AI

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE AND DISCOUNT FOR HER MAJESTY's SHIP
notes.content:
After receiving a ton of feedback from users,we decided to focus on the major issues raised.

* 50% Sale Discount 
* Brand new interactive tutorial
* New Endless Player Mode
* Refreshed UI / UX
* Improved AI

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 now LIVE !
notes.content:
We have been hard at work squashing all the bugs reported since launch, a big thanks to all who reported on the forum, greatly appreciated.

We are now working on the implementation of an Endless game play mode, along with a new set of achievements for the player to chase.

This new update should be live within the next two week, will keep all posted.

Thanks for the support.


Version 1.0.2
- Fixed Save Game bug
- Fixed Tutorial flow (Admiralty Order process)
- Fixed Various small bugs and spelling errors

Version 1.0.3
- Fixed occasional bug causing sailors being stuck in the longboat
- Improved tutorial camera behaviour
- Improved UI scaling on various resolutions
- Fixed various small graphics issues

Version 1.0.5
- Improved AI model (Fort building, Capturing Ports)
- Fixed Fort building bug (Player Admiralty Order)
- Turned Midshipman level difficulty down a notch

Version 1.0.6
- Fixed Marine Crew counter bug
- Changed Dutch flag to correct period flag (differentiate from French flag)

Version 1.0.7
- Ships stores can now be SOLD at the market for Gold

Version 1.0.8
- Updated Ai to improve Fort building and capture

Version 1.0.9
- Updated Ai to improve secondary target selection and resupply of enemy ships

Version 1.0.10
- Fixed Dutch warship following player after combat bug
- Updated New Dutch flag colors to all flags etc
- Fixed multiple Dutch Warship spawning bug
- Fixed enemy ships not disappearing from horizon after combat

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 now live on Steam
notes.content:
We thanks everyone for the feedback, we are currently working 24/7 on the following reported issues:

1. Updating Ai to prevent ship getting stuck on World Map
2. Sailors getting stuck at the Longboat Station
3. Improving odds to capture a Fort
4. Isolated reports of game not saving
5. Tutorial sequence fix (Admiralty order pop up)
6. Large Steam names breaking the UI panels

We will keep everyone updated and will patch as soon as we have tested.

After all bugs fixes, we will be considering a tactical pause and Endless mode, but the immediate bugs are the priority right now.
